title: US monthly equity expiration (November 2027) — two sessions after the FOMC minutes, and the last expiration before Thanksgiving week
source: OCC: The Options Clearing Corporation's own 2027 Options Expiration Calendar, re-fetched and re-decoded independently this session (2026-09-08) at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) -- the Options Industry Council surface whose every page footer reads '(c) The Options Clearing Corporation. All rights reserved.' Its legend maps GUID 6937B1D1-F5D5-46CD-BBE7-041C7BE7B85B to 'Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date and PM settled index options cease trading', and the data array carries exactly that type on 2027-11-19. The November block reads coherently end to end: 2027-11-11 'Bank holiday', 2027-11-17 EEF1643B (Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date), 2027-11-18 15AA2B9D (Monthly A.M. settled index options cease trading), 2027-11-19 the monthly equity / PM-settled index marker, 2027-11-25 'Exchange/OCC holiday'. VALIDATED AGAINST THIS REPO'S OWN ROWS BEFORE BEING TRUSTED, 12 OF 12: the same payload returns 2026's monthly equity expirations as 01-16, 02-20, 03-20, 04-17, 05-15, 06-18, 07-17, 08-21, 09-18, 10-16, 11-20, 12-18 -- every one its month's third Friday except the Juneteenth-displaced Thursday 2026-06-18, and all five dates this calendar already holds as confirmed (opex-2026-08-21, -09-18, -10-16, -11-20, -12-18) match exactly. A SECOND, STRUCTURAL VALIDATION THE OCTOBER SIBLING COULD NOT RUN: the payload's own 2027 series displaces June to Thursday 2027-06-17 because Juneteenth falls on Friday 2027-06-18, reproducing this repo's opex-2027-06-17 entry -- the displacement rule is exercised inside the same year being read, not only in 2026. INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATED BY THE THIRD-FRIDAY STANDARD, computed rather than assumed: 2027-11-01 is a Monday, so the Fridays of November 2027 are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th, and the third is 2027-11-19; the payload lists no November 2027 exchange closure before the 25th that could displace it. PROMOTED estimate -> confirmed here on market-events-data.ts's own OCC: prefix; the no-self-confirm convention binds the DISCOVERING sweep (fomc-minutes-2027-11-17, 2026-09-08) and this is the independent second look, the precedent opex-2027-09-17, opex-2027-10-15 and fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 record. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-08), shadowing the single proposal that filed it (proposals/opex-2027-11-19.from-fomc-minutes-2027-11-17.json, read in full first). IMPACT medium follows the class: this calendar's confirmed 2026 rows file monthlies (08-21, 10-16, 11-20) medium and quarterlies (09-18, 12-18) high, and November 2027 is a monthly, not a triple witching. WHAT THE LEDGER MEASURED, AND WHAT IT REFUSES. (1) THE MINUTES ADJACENCY IS INERT ON ALL THREE CHANNELS: across 158 monthly expirations 2007-2026, the 30 that fall exactly two sessions after an FOMC minutes release -- this event's exact geometry -- run a VIX change of -0.303 against -0.402 (permutation P = 0.775), an absolute S&P move of 0.724% against 0.704% (P = 0.901) and a following-five-session realized vol of 0.937 against 0.955 (P = 0.907). The configuration is also structural, not a 2027 property: it recurs in 30 of 158 monthlies, roughly one month in five. (2) THE ONE NUMBER THAT LOOKED LIKE AN EDGE IS REFUSED AT BIRTH: November monthly expirations run a VIX change of -1.244 against -0.266 for the other 138 (raw P = 0.023, era-ranked P = 0.036-0.038), but it does not survive dropping the single 2008-11-21 observation (-8.19; ex-2008 P = 0.151, ex-2008-2011 P = 0.180), it is one of EIGHT month tests so its family-wise Sidak P is 0.171 against a Bonferroni alpha of 0.00625, and it does not persist (following five sessions P = 0.934). Registered as a forward test, NOT banked and never sized. (3) THE OCTOBER SIBLING'S FRIDAY-CONTROL CORRECTION REPRODUCES INDEPENDENTLY on data through 2026-09-08: expiration vs all other sessions -0.364 vs +0.019 (P = 0.004), all Fridays vs non-Fridays -0.151 vs +0.039 (P = 0.007), expiration Fridays vs other Fridays -0.336 vs -0.095 (P = 0.088). (4) THIS EXPIRATION IS NOT A BLACKOUT DEADLINE -- the December 2027 gate opens Saturday 2027-11-27, whose deadline session is Friday 2027-11-26, the Thanksgiving half day; so opex-2027-10-15's deadline-cohort work does not transfer here and this event sits in the comparison cohort, not the treatment one. Same channel caveat as every entry in this class: symbols is empty and no house playbook is opex-keyed (re-grepped this session -- four matches, zero real hits, every one the substring 'pin' inside gapping / flipping / overlapping / dropping). Confirmed changes what we KNOW, never what we DO.
